name: zz Generic PLA Fast @BBL X2D 0.4 nozzle
description: Personal preset - the 'zz' prefix sorts it last in Bambu Studio's and Bambuddy's preset lists. Generic PLA with flow pushed for speed on the X2D: volumetric speed 20 on every variant (above Bambu's 12 for Generic PLA) and layer cooling cut to 4 s / 40 mm/s.
